name: bundle-check
title_zh: 开盘三分钟看出庄家左手倒右手的钱包簇
tagline_zh: 问一句「这币是不是被包场了」，它不吐整份报告，只回你开盘窗口的簇检测：谁在同步买入、谁在倒手出货，一眼看清。
tagline_en: Ask "was this bundled?" and get just the launch-window cluster check: synchronized buys, hand-off sells, no full.
desc_en: Fast check whether a token launch was bundled/sniped by a coordinated wallet cluster. Use when the user asks "was this bundled", "check the snipers", or wants the launch-window analysis without the full report.
why_zh: 别人给你看 K 线，它给你看钱包图谱。按地址簇而非单地址判定，能揪出拆成几十个小号。
why_en: Others show charts; it maps wallet clusters. Detects coordinated action split across dozens of addresses that individually look.
limit_zh: 只查代币 launch 后短窗口内的打包/狙击行为，不覆盖后续洗盘或老鼠仓。
limit_en: Only checks bundling/sniping in the launch window, not later wash trading. Needs a blockchain API key (e.g., Etherscan); without one, only sample.
title_en: Spot coordinated cluster bundling in the first 3 minutes
